ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (off-white/yellowish) pixels to low-intensity (black/grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark-intensity pigmentation is concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edges; diffuse tan/yellowish mottling is distributed across the central and medial regions of both lobes; a singular dark vertical streak is visible extending from the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow vertex; calculated pixel angle approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-12 units; significant jaggedness visible along the upper boundary of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the lower leading edge (relative to camera perspective) sweeping upward toward tapered, slightly pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered across the medial-left lobe and adjacent to the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least five parallel, high-contrast dark linear marks (rake marks) located on the distal upper edge of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake marks on the right fluke tip; irregular, jagged traumatic loss of tissue along the upper trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Pervasive yellowish-tan bio-film or staining covering approximately 65% of the white ventral pigment area.
